definitions.gloss: intermediate-level person; person at an intermediate level
definitions.explanation: Someone who has progressed beyond beginner level but has not yet reached advanced level in a skill, sport, language, or other area of study.

examples.japanese: この{教材|きょうざい}は{中級者|ちゅうきゅうしゃ}{向|む}けです。
examples.english: This textbook is for intermediate learners.

examples.japanese: {中級者|ちゅうきゅうしゃ}から{上級者|じょうきゅうしゃ}へのステップアップが{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: The step up from intermediate to advanced level is difficult.

examples.japanese: スキーの{中級者|ちゅうきゅうしゃ}コースは{傾斜|けいしゃ}がやや{急|きゅう}になっている。
examples.english: The intermediate ski course has a somewhat steep slope.

notes: A compound of {中級|ちゅうきゅう} (intermediate level) and {者|しゃ} (person). Part of a three-level series: {初級者|しょきゅうしゃ} (beginner), {中級者|ちゅうきゅうしゃ} (intermediate), {上級者|じょうきゅうしゃ} (advanced). Often used in the pattern {中級者|ちゅうきゅうしゃ}{向|む}け (aimed at intermediates) for courses, textbooks, and equipment.
